dayNotePrefix: Walk or bike the 16 closed miles of Suiattle River Road from the washout to the Downey Creek trailhead first.
why: Sources: fs.usda.gov/r06/mbs/alerts/suiattle-river-road-washout-closure (order 06-05-26-03, 2 Apr 2026-1 Jan 2028, motor vehicles only, closed at MP 4 from Suiattle Mountain Rd junction, no reopening date); fs.usda.gov Downey Creek Trail 768 page (7 Apr 2026, ~20 mi from SR530); WTA Downey Creek/Sulphur Creek pages and a May 2026 WTA trip report (foot/bike permitted, closure MP ~4-4.5, 5 more washouts beyond that are walkable; PCTA 29 May 2026 more pessimistic). Downey TH ~20-20.6 mi, closure ~4-4.5 => ~16 mi each way (own subtraction). Miner's Fire order 06-05-26-17 also closes Downey Creek TH/trail to 31 Dec 2026. No source gives added gain, so none added. Itinerary day miles 12/5/12 start at Downey TH (primary variant), so road added to first and last days.
